title: Add enforced vitest coverage thresholds to mongodb-mcp-server
description: In applications/mcp-gateway/repos/mongodb-mcp-server (default branch main, pinned aaa72a04), measure current coverage by running `pnpm test` (vitest --coverage --run) on main. Then add `coverage.thresholds` with numeric `lines`, `branches`, `functions` and `statements` to the coverage block of vitest.config.ts (currently lines 30-44, which set only exclude and reporter). Set each value to the floor of the measured baseline. Tests are sharded across jobs whose lcov is merged in the `coverage` job of .github/workflows/code-health.yml (lines 148-191, lcov-result-merger then coverallsapp). So either scope the thresholds to the `unit-and-integration` project run by the run-tests job, or add a step after the merge in the `coverage` job that exits non-zero when the merged coverage/lcov.info falls below the same floor. Either way, the gate must fail the workflow and not only report to Coveralls. Constraints: merge by pull request with 1 approval (releaseProcess.approvalsRequired). sdlc/policy.json defines no deploymentWindows or change freeze, and the change affects CI only.
acceptanceCriteria: vitest.config.ts on main contains coverage.thresholds with numeric lines, branches, functions and statements values no higher than the baseline measured on main (baseline figures recorded in the PR description).

A throwaway pull request that deletes one unit test file covering src/ code makes the Code Health workflow fail on the coverage threshold (a failing run URL is attached as task evidence), and the same PR without the deletion passes.
Re-running probe-sdlc on mcp-gateway/mongodb-mcp-server no longer produces fingerprint 7b28ad9bb3c053384d1fe7a3325f28d9a49a5b3a7ae170a36312672e49b5149b (rule ssdf-pw-8-2-no-coverage-threshold).

verificationMethod.description: Re-run probe-sdlc scoped to mcp-gateway/mongodb-mcp-server at the merge commit. Expected: the unit-tests gate observation for sebi-cscrf-2024:PR.IP.S6 reports thresholds present and enforced, and finding fnd_01M2GSDSE000HR9FYWXXSM4ZM3 is not re-produced (fingerprint 7b28ad9b... absent).

rootCause.description: The unit-tests gate was defined in policy as blocking, but nobody set a coverage floor. vitest.config.ts only configures exclude and an lcov reporter, so coverage is measured and uploaded but can never fail a build.
